content: Finally, the results in Figure FIGREF60 again verify the usefulness of unsupervised post-processing also in cross-lingual settings. We observe improved performance with both m-bert and xlm-100 when mean centering (+mc) is applied, and further gains can be achieved by using abtt on the mean-centered vector spaces. A similar finding also holds for static cross-lingual word embeddings, where applying abbt (-10) yields higher scores on 61/66 language pairs.
